create_metrics_container: create a MetricsContainer to register and track multiple named metrics like time, average, and percentage
record_time_metric: record elapsed time for an operation using TimeMetric reset and record methods
track_moving_average: track a moving average over a sliding window using MovingAverageMetric with a configurable window size
measure_ngram_overlap: measure n-gram overlap between a generated sentence and target text using NGramMetric
compute_uniqueness: compute the number of unique sentences generated using UniquenessMetric to track diversity
